# Timeline for the Implementation of the EU AI Act
The EU’s AI Act legislation applies progressively, with a full roll-out of the main application milestones foreseen by 2 August 2028. The timeline takes into account the AI Act amendments introduced by Digital Omnibus on AI.
1. 01 Aug 2024
  Entry into force
2. 02 Feb 2025
  General provisions (definitions & AI literacy) and prohibitions apply
3. 02 Aug 2025
  Rules for general-purpose AI apply and governance must be in place

...

5. 02 Dec 2026
  New prohibitions + Article 50(2) transition apply **

answer:
The EU AI Act entered into force on 1 August 2024 [4]. It applies progressively, with full roll-out by 2 August 2028 [2].

- General provisions on definitions, AI literacy and prohibitions applied from 2 February 2025 [1].
- Rules for general-purpose AI and EU governance applied from 2 August 2025 [1].
- The majority of the rules, including transparency requirements (Article 50) and measures supporting innovation, apply from 2 August 2026 [2].
- Enforcement of the AI Act starts on 2 August 2026 [1].
- Prohibitions on AI generating non-consensual sexual deepfakes and child sexual abuse material apply from 2 December 2026 [1].
- Member States should have at least one AI regulatory sandbox operational by 2 August 2027 [1].
- Obligations for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III enter into force on 2 December 2027 [2].
- Obligations for high-risk AI systems embedded in regulated products listed in Annex I enter into force on 2 August 2028 [2].
